title: Make atrium-refresh index every brain.pages directory, shared brains included, and fast-forward mounted shared repositories first
notes: bin/atrium-refresh runs ingest-notes only on $SYNTOPICA_DATA/pages, so a shared brain cloned at shared/vibra (Vibra-Lab/brain-vibra, listed in brain.pages of the office instance since 2026-11-24) is never re-indexed after a pull.

ingest-notes on the wiki root rejects the clone as git-ignored (12 files rejected on the office Mac); it must be run on the clone itself, with a provider of its own so the per-provider sweep does not remove the instance's notes. The office Mac and the MBP dotfiles refresh (dotfiles 21cc5d2) both carry a local loop for this.
The clone's README.md is indexed as a note today; only files under the configured page directories should be.
done_when: After git pull in a mounted shared brain, the next scheduled refresh indexes the changed page with no manual command, on an instance set up only by the hub.
